svg.text: both carry on to the chest
no ink above the collar line
Lumbar root · lunar axis · stacked diamonds · wing-root lock · crown blade.
Two wings of four rib-staves fold down across the shoulder blades.
The clavicle staves cross at the sternum and weave through the deltoid staves.
The diamond’s lowest point is left open; one hollow blade hangs beneath it.
Tally roll, back: 4 + 6 + 7 + 7 = 24 to a wing · 24 + 24 + the crown blade = 49
